steps.en: Start a Keycloak server (dev mode to try it; a real database for production)
steps.zh: 启动 Keycloak 服务（试用用开发模式，生产要接真正的数据库）

steps.en: In the admin console, create a realm and its users, or connect LDAP / Active Directory
steps.zh: 在管理控制台建 realm 和用户，或接入 LDAP、AD

steps.en: Register each app as an OpenID Connect client with its redirect URIs
steps.zh: 把每个应用注册成 OpenID Connect 客户端，填好回调地址

steps.en: Users hitting the app are sent to Keycloak's login page; it checks password, 2FA or an external IdP
steps.zh: 用户被转到 Keycloak 登录页，由它校验密码、二次验证或外部身份源

component.zh: 登录流程与单点登录会话

steps.en: Redirects back to the app with signed tokens carrying identity and roles
steps.zh: 带着签名令牌跳回应用，令牌里有身份和角色

steps.en: The app verifies the token with a standard OIDC library and reads the roles
steps.zh: 应用用标准 OIDC 库校验令牌，读出角色

value.en: One login, one place to disable an account or require 2FA — apps stop storing passwords
value.zh: 一次登录，一个地方停用账号或强制二次验证——各应用不再自己存密码

sources: https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/blob/main/docs/guides/getting-started/templates/first-app.adoc (create OpenID Connect client, Valid redirect URIs, sign in via Keycloak)
